_comment: Rails are adapters. An empty trc20 address or telegram.enabled=false disables that rail without breaking anything else — the service keeps verifying, keeps writing the public feed, and keeps recording every delivery attempt and failure.

trc20.note: Paste a TRC-20 receiving address to switch this rail on. Never invent an address; an invoice to the wrong address is worse than no invoice.

stars.note: 500 Stars ≈ $6.50 at the desktop payout rate (~$0.013/Star). 1,000-Star minimum withdrawal, 21-day hold, cash-out via Fragment needs the bot owner's Telegram + TON wallet.

telegram.note: Delivery adapter, not a new bot: point it at a bot token whose owner has agreed to carry this product. A bot cannot create a channel; it can post to one where it is an admin.

tiers.watch: $8/mo or 500 Stars: push alerts for the tracked tools (release / drift / integrity failure)
tiers.team: $49/mo: your own watchlist (private images, SBOMs, internal tools) + webhook into CI
